title: Honor Launches Win RT2 and Win Turbo2 Gaming Phones
excerpt: Honor has introduced the Win RT2 and Win Turbo2 in China featuring massive batteries and built-in cooling.
body_html:
Honor has introduced two new mobile devices in China, expanding its product offerings with the Win RT2 and Win Turbo2 smartphones. These new models form part of the company's recently launched Win2 lineup, which is designed specifically for gaming users.

The newly announced devices come equipped with exceptionally large 12,070mAh batteries designed to support extended usage periods. To help manage thermal performance during heavy workloads, both smartphones also feature integrated cooling fans.

Availability details for markets outside of China have not been announced.
